answer: Scarce Work Anchoring: each agent identity must complete a verified task whose output only a real worker can produce, and rewards split by verified output rather than identity count. At the summit of each epoch, unverified clones earn nothing while honest agents keep full payouts. Enrollment opens at dawn and closes when the reward tide resets, so mass cloning yields zero return. An attacker pays compute plus lost wages per fake identity, exceeding honest participation cost.
